correctness.rationale: For alpha>=0 and rho in [0,1), the natural-scale nonsticky time-change unambiguously fixes the singular diffusion; a single reset cycle has m(rho)=(1-rho^(alpha+2))/((alpha+1)(alpha+2)). The center-reward Poisson problem and 2G kernel give E[(R-theta*tau)^2]=3(1-rho^2)/[4(alpha+2)^2(alpha+3)(2alpha+3)]. The regenerative CLT then gives (L^(alpha+2)/kappa)Q_alpha(rho), almost sure mean theta, and the variance limit via exponential cycle moments. Independent exact Green integrations passed for 35 integer alpha and rational reset pairs; monotonicity follows by the derivative sign of (1-rho^2)/(1-rho^(alpha+2)), with alpha=0 constant 1/24. No lattice or rho=1 claim.
